BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is the sin offering, and at the dedication of the house of God the returned exiles offer twelve he goats for a sin offering for all Israel, one for each tribe. The offering covers the whole people at once.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the twelve goats show that the whole of Israel needed covering, and God provided one offering for every tribe.
